Agent Attention — Which One Is Asking?

Features·seedling·accepted·JUL 21, 2026

When an agent asks a question, kolu shows a count on the host tab and a faint dot on the dock entry — but you must hunt for which agent, and the "asking" dot is the quietest mark in the palette. Two fixes off state the client already holds; the third (the question text) is scoped as a separate, brittler pass.

Contents

  • AD1 — the awaiting pill becomes a jump button
  • AD2 — a genuinely-blocked agent gets its own pip
  • Option 3 — the question text — is deferred
  • What ships here

An agent asks a question (AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode); kolu shows an amber count on the host tab and an orange mark on the dock entry. The signal exists but is weak on both ends of what you ask:

  • Which agent? The pill gives a count, never which — you scan the dock by eye.
  • Is it important? The asking mark is the faintest pip in the palette (6px, 55% opacity), while the lower-stakes unread badge pulses.PIP_BODY.awaiting is w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-alert/55 — packages/solid-statepip/src/pipVariant.ts. The loudness hierarchy is inverted.

Both fix off facts the client already holds — no wire field, no new sensing. This ships AD1 + AD2; the question text (option 3) is deferred.

AD1 — the awaiting pill becomes a jump button

The urgency cell already carries the waiting terminals’ ids ({ awaitingIds }), packages/padi/src/urgency.ts but the UI projects them down to .length. packages/client/src/host/useHostAwaiting.ts So AD1 is wiring:

  • useHostAwaiting returns the ids; the three readers use .length for the badge.
  • HostAwaitingPill gains onActivate and renders as a <button>. In HostChip it moves out of the role="tab" button to a sibling, so no button nests in a button.The remove-✕ is already a sibling of the tab button for the same reason (nested interactive elements are invalid HTML). AD1 follows that precedent.
  • Clicking runs setActiveHost then tileStore.activate, cycling awaitingIds — the same switch-then-activate seam the cross-host notification click uses,useHostAttention’s notify.onClick does setActiveHost then focusTerminal (the store’s activate) — packages/client/src/host/useHostAttention.ts. AD1 reuses it rather than inventing a second focus path. so a badge click and a notification click behave identically.

AD2 — a genuinely-blocked agent gets its own pip

The paint fold collapses two states into one amber dot: blocked on your answer (awaiting_user) and just finished (waiting). packages/terminal-vocab/src/agentProjection.ts The lingering dim glow for a finished agent is correct; the bug is that the one asking now whispers at the same volume. AD2 splits only the loud end out:

  • A new blocked pip variant in @kolu/solid-statepip — full-opacity, larger, pulsing — versus the unchanged dim awaiting dot.
  • Promoted through the existing agentBucket fence (awaiting_user → "awaiting"), packages/terminal-vocab/src/agentProjection.ts so paintDockRow and agentPipVariant promote to blocked and everything else folds through the shared paint class unchanged.

Why not split the shared AgentPaintClass?

Wrong-sized cut: AgentPaintClass also feeds the tile aura, minimap, and switcher columns, so blocked there forces a new switcher column and a louder aura on every tile. Keeping it dock-local (DockRowBucket + the tile-title pip) touches only the two surfaces in the complaint. The dock row pip ≡ tile-title pip parity holds, because both promote through the same agentBucket check.Pinned by the parity test at packages/client/src/canvas/dock/dockRowRanking.test.ts.

Option 3 — the question text — is deferred

Showing the question in the dock subtitle is a bigger, brittler pass. The plumbing is cheap (one nullable field + a one-line rowSubline.ts change), but the text isn’t readable while the question is pending: kolu tails the JSONL transcript, and the Claude Agent SDK buffers the AskUserQuestion block off-disk until you answer. packages/integrations/claude-code/src/agent-adapter.ts The only live source is the rendered screen, which the adapter scrapes for footer chrome only, no text. packages/integrations/claude-code/src/screen.ts Extracting the body means a version-sensitive parser that buys only Claude Code.

If we ever do it, use a hook not a scraper

A PreToolUse hook on AskUserQuestion hands over the exact text non-brittly — but the adapter uses no hooks today, so it’s a new integration mechanism, and its own note.

What ships here

Shipped in #1926 — neither track adds a wire field or a sensing path:

Track Change Blast radius
AD1 Awaiting pill → jump button (cycles awaitingIds) useHostAwaiting, HostAwaitingPill, HostChip + two pill readers
AD2 blocked pip for a genuinely-asking agent @kolu/solid-statepip, paintDockRow, dock pipVariant, TerminalMeta, one index.css rule
